{{Top}}
[[File:Falcon_droid_brains.jpg|thumb|250px|The Intellex V on the left]]
The '''Intellex V''' [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] was the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system used by [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series astromech droids]]. It was produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] and an improvement over the [[Intellex IV/Legends|Intellex IV]] of the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]]. It contained a database of statistics on every ship used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
